blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — The city government here has filed a robbery complaint against a former employee for allegedly stealing rice and other supplies from its warehouse, Mayor Erlinda Araquil said. Araquil said they filed the complaint with the City Prosecutor’s Office last Tuesday against the former employee over the alleged theft of government property from the city’s warehouse. The case involves the reported loss of 31 bags of rice weighing 10 kilograms each, or a total of 310 kilograms.
